div.div: Solid candles are observed Coinbase Spot candles; translucent candles are the independent Traced Price Path. Live refreshes every 15 minutes. Hover a flow card for Theta/Vega details. This panel does not feed any other indicator engine.
One short-term and one structural target at most. Calculations are probabilistic and display-only; they do not feed Forecast or Signal Bot.

The central curve connects expiry Gamma levels in date order. The shaded range uses IV/Vega for width and Delta for asymmetry; Theta only reduces the estimated relevance of older trade flow. Public trades do not prove positions are still open or identify market makers. Expiry dates anchor the timeline, not promised price-touch dates. This module does not feed any other indicator engine.
